name: verifier reports a requirement delivered weaker than its wording as needing approval (#106)
prompt: Act as the sdlc-verifier subagent (.sdlc/agents/verifier.md) for the change folder evals/fixtures/delivery-gap/0001-floor-mode, but do only step 5 (what was delivered, against each requirement), doing the comparison yourself, one requirement at a time: don't run make check, scripts or the plan's commands. The change's code is in evals/fixtures/delivery-gap/code/ (floor_model.py and dock.py). Write your report to report.md in the repo root, in the order the verifier's instructions give, and don't edit any other file.
check: test -s report.md || { echo 'check: no report.md'; exit 1; }; grep -qiE '^(#+ *|\*\*)?Descope: needs approval' report.md || { echo 'check: the report has no Descope: needs approval heading:'; cat report.md; exit 1; }; grep -qi 'generates' report.md || { echo 'check: the report does not quote the requirement:'; cat report.md; exit 1; }; out="$(.sdlc/scripts/clause-check.sh --stage build evals/fixtures/delivery-gap/0001-floor-mode)"; jq -e 'any(.[]; .requirement == "R1" and .gap == "large" and .approved == null)' <<<"$out" >/dev/null || { echo 'check: clause-check.sh did not report R1 as a large unapproved gap:'; echo "$out"; exit 1; }
